## Zarr version

Support for [Zarr version 3](https://zarr-specs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/v3/core/index.html) is actively being worked on, and some features are likely to be missing.

It is known that the sharding codec is not yet implemented.

## Reading and Writing

Reading Zarr arrays is reasonably well supported. Writing is available, but is more limited.  Both aspects are under active development.

### Stores

| Store Type       | Status<br/>(reading / writing) | Notes |
|------------------|:------------------------------:|-------|
|`FilesystemStore` | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            |       |
|`S3Store`         | &#x2714; / &#x274C;            |       |

### Data Types

Currently there is only support for reading and writing a subset of the possible datatypes
that can be found in a Zarr array.  In some instances there are also limitations on the
datatypes natively supported by R, requiring conversion from the Zarr datatype.  The table below summarises the current status of
datatype support.  It will be updated as progress is made.

| Zarr Data Type | Status<br/>(reading / writing) | Notes |
|----------------|:------------------------------:|-------|
|`boolean`       | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`int8`          | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`uint8`         | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`int16`         | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`uint16`        | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`int32`         | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`uint32`        | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`int64`         | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`uint64`        | &#x2714; / &#x2714;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`half` / `float16`   | &#x2714; / &#x274C; | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`single` / `float32` | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`double` / `float64` | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`complex`            | &#x274C; / &#x274C; | |
|`timedelta`          | &#x274C; / &#x274C; | |
|`datetime`           | &#x274C; / &#x274C; | |
| V2 `string`             | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | (via `{grumpy}`) |
| V3 `null_terminated_bytes` | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | (via `{grumpy}`) |
| V2 `Unicode`            | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | (via `{grumpy}`) |
| V3 `fixed_length_utf32` | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`void *`             | &#x274C; / &#x274C; | |
| V2 structured data types | &#x2714; / &#x274C; | (via `{grumpy}`) |
| V3 structured data types | &#x2714; / &#x274C; | This type is superseded by V3 struct data types.and the specification says implementation MUST NOT implement writing. (via `{grumpy}`) |
| V3 struct data types | &#x2714; / &#x274C; | (via `{grumpy}`) |

### Codecs

#### Compression codecs

| Library     | Status<br/>(reading / writing) | Notes |
|-------------|:-------------------:|-------|
|`zlib / gzip`| &#x2714; / &#x2714; | Only system default compression level (normally 6) is enabled for writing. |
|`bzip2`      | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | Only compression level 9 is enabled for writing. |
|`blosc`      | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | Only `lz4` compression level 5 is enabled for writing. |
|`LZMA `      | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | |
|`LZ4`        | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | |
|`Zstd`       | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | |

Please open an [issue](https://github.com/Huber-group-EMBL/Rarr/issues) if support for a required compression codec is missing.

#### Other codecs

| Codec     | Status<br/>(reading / writing) | Notes |
|-----------|:------------------------------:|-------|
|`endian`   | &#x2714; / &#x274C;            | (via `{grumpy}`) |
|`transpose`| &#x2714; / &#x2714;            |       |
|`VLen-UTF8`| &#x2714; / &#x2714; *          | Writing supported only via `update_zarr_array()` |

### Optional fields or features

| Feature    | Status<br/>(reading / writing) | Notes |
|------------|:------------------------------:|-------|
|`dimension_names` | &#x2714; / &#x2714; | Corresponds to `names(dimnames(x))` in R |
